import json,sys,csv,logging,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root));local=Path(__file__).parent
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_snapshot import scan_reviews,committed_reviews
from ground_truth_studio.config import Settings
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_service import load_queue
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
from src.domain_adaptation import read_yolo_boxes,validate_class_mapping
from src.scene_subset import build_subset
import yaml
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/policy_20261116_20b050e6';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
def save(name,data):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
class Capture(logging.Handler):
 def __init__(self):super().__init__(logging.ERROR);self.messages=[]
 def emit(self,record):self.messages.append(record.getMessage())
capture=Capture();logging.getLogger('ground_truth_studio.bbox_snapshot').addHandler(capture)
private=Settings.load().private;records,issues=scan_reviews(private);committed_reviews(private)
assert not any(i['status']=='INTEGRITY_QUARANTINED' for i in issues) and not capture.messages
logging.getLogger('ground_truth_studio.bbox_snapshot').removeHandler(capture)
queue={r['image_sha256']:r for r in load_queue(root)};latest={r['image_sha256']:r for r in records}
approved=[r for r in latest.values() if r['decision']=='APPROVE'];classes=Counter();composition=Counter();by_source=Counter();by_split=Counter();keyword=[];candidates=[]
proofdir=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/finalize_20261115_9f8bacb3/lineage'
reserved={'TRAIN_CANDIDATE':'train','TRAIN_LEGACY_RESERVATION':'train','VALIDATION_CANDIDATE':'val','VAL_LEGACY_RESERVATION':'val'}
for review in approved:
 q=queue[review['image_sha256']];label=Path(review['label_version_path']);boxes=read_yolo_boxes(label)
 assert sha256(label)==review['label_sha256'] and sha256(root/review['image_path'])==review['image_sha256']
 found={int(b[0]) for b in boxes};classes.update('SMOKE' if int(b[0])==0 else 'FIRE' for b in boxes)
 composition['NEGATIVE' if not found else 'BOTH' if len(found)==2 else 'SMOKE_ONLY' if 0 in found else 'FIRE_ONLY']+=1
 by_source[q['video_id']]+=1;by_split[q['reserved_split']]+=1
 evidence=str(review.get('evidence_ref','')).lower()
 if any(word in evidence for word in ('weld','hàn','tia lửa')):keyword.append({'image_sha256':review['image_sha256'],'image_name':q['image_name'],'reason':'KEYWORD_ONLY; NOT_SEMANTIC_LABEL'})
 path=proofdir/(review['image_sha256']+'.json');proof=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if path.exists() else {}
 candidates.append(dict(q,split=reserved.get(q['reserved_split'],'test_or_blocked'),human_approved=True,
   lineage_verified=proof.get('status') in ['VERIFIED_NATIVE_DECODE','VERIFIED_DERIVED_IMAGE'],source_video_sha256=proof.get('source_video_sha256')))
blocked={'3ed5b015393ce74d1da992dece66ce4a4b7abcd4b77ce5d3d23264794c4eacbe'}
subset=build_subset(candidates,set(),blocked);save('clean_subset_manifest.json',subset)
save('annotation_impact.json',{'policy_status':'PROPOSED_PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL','approved_images':len(approved),
 'bbox_counts':dict(classes),'image_composition':dict(composition),'by_source':dict(by_source),'by_reservation':dict(by_split),
 'keyword_candidates':keyword,'actual_welding_image_count':None,'reason':'No authenticated per-image welding ontology tags; keyword absence is not evidence of absence',
 'labels_modified':0,'automatic_relabels':0,'policy_sha256':sha256(root/'docs/WEEK5_FIRE_SMOKE_WELDING_POLICY_PROPOSAL.md')})
save('integrity_gate.json',{'timestamp':datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=7))).isoformat(),'status':'PASS',
 'resolved':sum(i['status']=='RESOLVED_BY_HUMAN_RECONFIRMATION' for i in issues),'unresolved':0,
 'strict_export_integrity':'PASS','historical_resolved_error_logs':capture.messages,
 'valid_versions':len(records),'unique_valid_images':len(latest),'decisions':dict(Counter(r['decision'] for r in latest.values())),
 'resolution_checksums':{i['resolution_id']:i['resolution_sha256'] for i in issues},'new_human_approvals_created_by_agent':0})
source_yaml=root/'datasets/dfire_author_linked_kaggle_v1/data.yaml';source=yaml.safe_load(source_yaml.read_text());validate_class_mapping(source['names'])
parent=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/scene_20261115_72a6d1eb'
for name in ['scene_group_manifest.json','human_source_shortlist.json','scene_summary.json','baseline_membership.json','new_baseline_protocol.json','clean_dfire_manifest.json']:
 save(name,json.loads((parent/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
save('parents.json',{p.name:sha256(p) for p in parent.glob('*.json')})
protocol=json.loads((parent/'new_baseline_protocol.json').read_text());assert sha256(root/protocol['initialization_path'])==protocol['initialization_sha256']
save('readiness.json',{'gates':{'BBOX_INTEGRITY_READY':True,'SPLIT_READY':False,'VN_BBOX_READY':False,'DFIRE_READY':False,'RESOURCE_PILOT_READY':False,'WEEK5_TRAINING_READY':False},
 'eligible_train':subset['train_count'],'eligible_val':subset['val_count'],'eligible_test':0,
 'class_mapping':['smoke','fire'],'source_yaml_sha256':sha256(source_yaml),
 'baseline_membership':'BASELINE_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_VERIFIED','initialization_sha256':protocol['initialization_sha256'],
 'pilot':{'status':'NOT_RUN_NO_VALID_TRAIN_VAL','measurements':None},'experiments':{'runs':0,'epochs':0,'seeds_completed':0,'metrics':None},
 'blockers':['SOURCE_SCENE_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED','BASELINE_MEMBERSHIP_NOT_VERIFIED'],
 'sample_size_suitability':'NOT_ESTABLISHED; empty eligible subset cannot satisfy research sample-size requirements',
 'proposal_changes_current_labels':False,'original_test_reservations_preserved':True})
# Reproduce existing approved export without writing a duplicate large bundle.
existing=root/'.tools/bbox_resolution_logfix_20261116/approved_export'
checks=json.loads((existing/'sha256.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert all(sha256(existing/p)==v for p,v in checks.items())
backup=root/'.tools/bbox_integrity_20261116/raw_backup';original=json.loads((backup/'checksums.json').read_text());assert all(sha256(backup/p)==v for p,v in original.items());assert all(sha256(private/p)==v for p,v in original.items() if not p.endswith('.sqlite3'))
save('export_reproducibility.json',{'existing_export_checksum_sha256':sha256(existing/'sha256.json'),'all_export_files_verified':True,
 'backup_and_original_forensic_versions_unchanged':True,'strict_current_storage_pass':True,
 'note':'Existing export fixed snapshot verified; current approval counts may be higher. No label or receipt regeneration.'})
print(json.dumps({'approved':len(approved),'composition':dict(composition),'boxes':dict(classes),'resolved':len(issues),'eligible_train':subset['train_count'],'eligible_val':subset['val_count']}))

import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];sys.path.insert(0,str(root))
from ground_truth_studio.bbox_service import load_queue
from ground_truth_studio.integrity_service import sha256
out=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/policy_20261116_20b050e6'
subset=json.loads((out/'clean_subset_manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
queue={r['image_sha256']:r for r in load_queue(root)}
proofdir=root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/finalize_20261115_9f8bacb3/lineage'
impact=Counter();by_source={}
for row in subset['excluded']:
 key=row['image_sha256'];path=proofdir/(key+'.json')
 if path.exists():
  proof=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'));source=proof.get('source_video_sha256')
  if source:
   by_source.setdefault(source,set()).add((queue[key]['video_id'],queue[key]['source_path_candidate']))
   if proof['status'] in ['VERIFIED_NATIVE_DECODE','VERIFIED_DERIVED_IMAGE']:impact[source]+=1
rows=[{'source_pair':pair,'approved_lineage_impact':sum(impact[s] for s in pair),
       'sources':[{'sha256':s,'source_records':[{'video_id':v,'path':p} for v,p in sorted(by_source.get(s,set()))]} for s in pair],
       'status':'UNRESOLVED','required_evidence':'Independent source/camera/scene evidence and human decision; representative similarity alone insufficient',
       'selection_uses_test_metrics':False} for pair in subset['unresolved_source_pairs']]
rows.sort(key=lambda r:(-r['approved_lineage_impact'],r['source_pair']))
(out/'human_source_shortlist_current.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
(out/'lineage_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'previous_full_receipt_scope':1922,'verified':797,'unresolved':1125,
 'approved_in_snapshot':len(subset['excluded'])+len(subset['rows']),
 'approved_verified_by_source':dict(impact),'current_opposing_source_pairs':len(rows),
 'lineage_parent_receipts_sha256':sha256(root/'runs/benchmarks/week5_domain_adaptation/finalize_20261115_9f8bacb3/combined_lineage_summary.json')},indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(len(rows))

import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];local=Path(__file__).parent
env=os.environ.copy();env.update(OMP_NUM_THREADS='1',MKL_NUM_THREADS='1',YOLO_AUTOINSTALL='false',PYTHONIOENCODING='utf-8')
env['PATH']=str(root/'.tools/ffmpeg')+os.pathsep+env['PATH']
report=root/'docs/multicamera_rtsp_benchmark_report.md';before=report.read_bytes();results=[]
commands=[('targeted',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests/test_annotation_policy.py','tests/test_scene_subset.py','tests/test_domain_adaptation.py','tests/test_bbox_resolution.py','tests/test_bbox_integrity_recovery.py','tests/test_week5_readiness.py','tests/test_bbox_qa.py','tests/test_gt_studio_ui.py']),('full',[sys.executable,'-m','pytest','-q','tests'])]
try:
 for name,command in commands:
  log=local/(name+'.log');start=time.perf_counter()
  with log.open('w',encoding='utf-8') as stream:r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=env,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  results.append({'name':name,'command':command,'exit_code':r.returncode,'duration_seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'log':log.relative_to(root).as_posix(),'tail':log.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').splitlines()[-2:]})
  (local/'tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');print(json.dumps(results[-1]),flush=True)
finally:report.write_bytes(before)
sys.exit(0 if all(r['exit_code']==0 for r in results) else 1)
